description: Implement every finding from the 2026-08-17 Hancho factory review: crash recovery, repository leases, durable step attempts, idempotent external effects, safe timeout and cancellation ownership, atomic audit transitions, phase-aware queue resume, branch-safe landing, workflow compilation, repository-local Harness state, bounded verification output, typed durable records, architectural boundary cleanup, and a production release check.
